engine.title: Transport orders wait up to 19 h with "Ziel voll" – shown as orange labels in Halle 3D and a red KPI in Material
engine.evidence:
The material flow logic creates transport orders hours before the destination machine has room. Example: TR-0059 M01→M02 for FA-24122 was created at 08:44, but its AG 20 at INDEX G220 only starts around 20:35.
What the prospect sees:
• Halle 3D labels: "Ziel voll · seit 53 min" at 08:40, "seit 5 h 11 min" at 13:55, "seit 7 h 16 min" at 16:00, "seit 10 h 59 min" at 22:30, "seit 19 h 29 min" Tue 07:00.
• Material KPI "Offene Transporte 10 – längste Wartezeit 19 h 28 min" in red (crit) on Tue 07:00.
• Every waiting row has a red "Offen" pill, while both AGVs sit at the charging station with 21 % utilisation.
Screenshots: /tmp/rv-prospect/04-1355-halle.png, 04-1600-halle.png, 04-2230-halle.png, 04-di0700-halle.png, 04-di0700-material.png, 02-full-material.png.
Any logistics person reads this as "the AGV system is broken", and it is the most visible thing on the 3D showpiece.
engine.fix:
Engine (10_sim.js, around lines 3088–3215):
• Do not open a transport order (or do not start its wait clock) while the destination input buffer is full.
• Keep the container as "Bereitgestellt am Ausgang / im Pufferlager – Abruf, sobald <Ziel> Platz hat (Start ca. hh:mm)".
• If the source output would overflow, move the container to PUF.
• Reserve one input slot of each machine for the op that is currently running. Today M02 briefly starves ("Wartet auf Material – Behälter (30 Stk) ist unterwegs", 09:02 in the tour) while 2 of its 3 slots hold FA-24119 material for later.
45_material.js: count only due transports (phase ≠ 'geplant') in "Offene Transporte", the red KPI and the längste Wartezeit. Show planned ones as a neutral "n vorgemerkt" line.
30_hall3d.js: drop the "Ziel voll" stop labels for planned items. Show at most one neutral chip per destination, e.g. "Eingang M02 voll · 2 Behälter vorgemerkt" in --mat at 60 % opacity.

engine.title: After a fault the delivery ETA does not react, and the Copilot answer contradicts itself (demo script step 4)
engine.evidence:
Steps: fault on M07 Tiefbohren via drawer → "Störung simulieren" → "Störung auslösen" (ALM 2104), then ask the Copilot "Was bedeutet das für FA-24118?".
What the engine returns:
• forecast().orders['FA-24118'].etaRaw jumps to Di 15:13.
• The published eta stays Di 14:55 with etaPending = null until about 08:48 (q4.js trace).
• At 30× that is 10–20 s of real time, exactly when the presenter is talking.
Aufträge card (/tmp/rv-prospect/06-fault-auftraege.png): Studer "ab 16:42", Messraum "ab 19:36" (both shifted), but Prognose still "morgen 14:55, Puffer 1 h 04 min". There is no "neu … wird geprüft" hint.
Copilot (/tmp/rv-prospect/06-fault-copilot.png), all in one card:
• header "Puffer 1 h 04 min"
• text "morgen 14:55 → morgen 15:07 (+11 min; Puffer 53 min)"
• AG 60 Messraum "fertig ca. Di 14:57" but AG 70 Versand "ca. Di 14:55", so shipping happens before final inspection
• Empfehlung "nur mit Puffer 1 h 04 min"
engine.fix:
10_sim.js forecast stabilisation (etaStable / etaPending):
• Bypass the hysteresis on structural events (fault start/end, repair, setPriority, moveOp, addOrder, planRemake) and publish etaRaw immediately.
• Otherwise set etaPending at once, so 41_orders.js shows "neu 15:07 – wird geprüft".
• Never let the Versand step end before the last op's plannedEnd.
60_ai.js order card: take header, KPI tiles, prose, step list and Empfehlung from one source. Either all from the post-fault whatIf/etaRaw, labelled "neu gerechnet", or all from the published eta. Show "vorher 14:55 → jetzt 15:07" once, in the header.

engine.evidence:

engine.title: Evening shift never acts on the Geisterschicht-Check's own advice, so every night 3 of 4 autonomous machines stop

copilot.title: Copilot loss-by-cause gives wrong € and minutes (contradicts Analyse after a ghost-shift night)
copilot.evidence: Di 08:40, after one night: Analyse/engine lossByState shows 'Wartet auf Werkzeug 2.057 € in 18 h 09 min (77 %)' and 'Werkzeugwechsel 68 € in 38 min'. Copilot 'Was kostet uns der Stillstand heute?' answers 'Werkzeugwechsel 1.661 € – 38 min an 4 Arbeitsplätzen · 62 %' and 'Warten auf Werkzeug 463 € – 9 min'. That is about 2.600 €/h for a tool change. Per machine it says 'M05 847 € · Werkzeugwechsel 13 min, Warten auf Werkzeug 4 min · 135 €/h'. During the day the € values are also off by 1–2 € (Copilot Rüsten 159 / Bediener 55 / WZW 40 / Störung 15 vs Analyse 160 / 57 / 39 / 16 at Mo 08:40). Cause: lossByCause() (lines ~587–608) spreads mv.lossEurToday over segments × workBetween(), which drops the ghost-shift seconds. Screenshot: /tmp/rv-consistency/ai_cost_di0840.png (Analyse and Copilot side by side).
copilot.fix: Replace the apportioning in lossByCause() with the engine values that Analyse uses (ENGINE_API §2): € per cause = Σ mv.lossByState[state]; duration = Σ mv.plannedStateTimes[state]; machines = count of mv with lossByState[state] > 0.005. Include starved/blocked/waitTool. Use the same per-machine data for the 'Nach Arbeitsplatz' list. Add a self-check: Σ causes equals kpis().lossEur within ±1 €.

copilot.title: Rankings return the opposite of what is asked for energy, downtime cost and scrap (ansRanking)

copilot.title: Fault answer (README demo step 4) shows two different forecasts in one card: smoothed eta vs etaRaw

Head 'FA-24118 hält knapp – Puffer 1 h 04 min', KPI tile 'Prognose Di 14:55', delay bar 'Restlaufzeit bis zur Prognose Di 14:55', recommendation 'Termin hält, aber nur mit Puffer 1 h 04 min'. When etaRaw differs from eta by 60 s or more (etaPending, or a fault on a station of the order), drive head, KPI tiles, slack, delay-bar caption and recommendation from etaRaw. Label the changed value 'neu gerechnet (Störung)' and show the smoothed value only as 'bisher 14:55'. Apply the same rule in ansOverview, ansRisk and ansHandover, and drop the internal text 'Eine Neuberechnung (heute 10:02) wird gerade bestätigt'.

tour-shell.title: UI refresh rate collapses when the frame rate drops, because the tick accumulator uses the clamped frame dt
tour-shell.evidence: In loop(): `dt = Math.min(0.1, (now-last)/1000); acc += dt; if (acc >= 0.25) tick()`. At 2 fps the UI (views, drawer, notification panel) refreshes only every 1.5 s, while sim time follows real time. With software GL (Material 1–4 fps) an open order drawer did not refresh for several seconds while the sim moved on.
tour-shell.fix: Accumulate real elapsed time for the tick (`acc += Math.min(1, (now - lastTickT)/1000)`), or drive tick() from setInterval(250) independent of rAF. Keep the 0.1 s clamp only for frame(dt) animations.

leitstand-machine.title: Leitstand update() forces synchronous layout every tick (clipX); at 600× it exceeds the frame budget
